notes.title: Manga RPG is live on Steam
notes.content:
Big day to press the big button, we are very happy to be live on Steam. 
 
We will be reviewing if there are any trouble with the game, so far we are identified an issue on Mac Silicon and we are working on it. 

It's our first release on Steam, so it will require some polish and fixes for sure.

But we really hope you will enjoy the ride and discover the amazing adventure of Manga RPG in the best conditions possible.
